quotes.quote: The whole set of transcript data can be found in the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) database (BioProject ID: PRJNA774916 ).

The differentially expressed genes were analyzed with DESeq2 ( Love, Wolfgang & Simon, 2014 ). A total of 4,820 genes were differentially expressed in the flowers of safflower during colour transition, among which 2,018 genes were downregulated and 2,802 genes were upregulated ( Fig. 4 ).

G1.rationale: The principal result (differential expression counts) is produced by a computational analysis (DESeq2) on RNA-seq data deposited at NCBI under PRJNA774916, which a third party can re-run.

G2.rationale: One principal quantitative result is clearly named: the number of differentially expressed genes (4,820 total; 2,018 down; 2,802 up), reported as a primary numerical endpoint in the Results.

The library preparations were sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq platform with three biological replicates in each group.

G3.rationale: The deposit contains raw sequencing reads (SRR16588097) which are the analysis inputs for the differential expression target, not its outputs.

quotes.quote: The gene expression levels were calculated through RSEM (RNAseq by Expectation-Maximization) v1.2.12 ( Li & Colin, 2011 ). DESeq2 ( Love, Wolfgang & Simon, 2014 ) was used for differential expression analysis. Read counts of genes are the expected count outputs calculated using RSEM.

After discrepancy analysis, multiple hypothesis tests are needed to correct the hypothesis test probability ( P value) with the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure to obtain the false discovery rate (FDR) when |log2fold change| ≥ 1 and FDR < 0.05.

G4.rationale: The method for the target (differential expression analysis) is described with specific tools (RSEM v1.2.12, DESeq2), thresholds (|log2FC| ≥ 1, FDR < 0.05), and correction procedure (Benjamini-Hochberg), sufficient to implement without original code.

method_quotes.quote: The gene expression levels were calculated through RSEM (RNAseq by Expectation-Maximization) v1.2.12 ( Li & Colin, 2011 ). DESeq2 ( Love, Wolfgang & Simon, 2014 ) was used for differential expression analysis. Read counts of genes are the expected count outputs calculated using RSEM.

After discrepancy analysis, multiple hypothesis tests are needed to correct the hypothesis test probability ( P value) with the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure to obtain the false discovery rate (FDR) when |log2fold change| ≥ 1 and FDR < 0.05.

In this project, Trinity v2.0.6 ( Grabherr et al., 2011 ) was used to splice the filtered high-quality sequencing data to obtain the transcriptome, which was used as the reference sequence for subsequent differential expression analysis.

specification.input_notes: The deposit lists one run accession SRR16588097 under BioProject PRJNA774916. This is raw RNA-seq data. The paper states three biological replicates per group (Day 2 and Day 4), but only one run is listed; additional runs may be missing or not listed. The transcriptome assembly (Trinity) is used as reference, but the assembly itself is not deposited; it must be regenerated from raw reads.

leakage_files.name: SRR16588097
leakage_files.reason: This is the raw input data, not a leakage file; it does not contain the target value. No listed files contain the target value or derived result tables.

specification.comparison_metric: Exact match of the reported counts: total differentially expressed genes, number downregulated, and number upregulated.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Counts must match exactly: 4,820 total, 2,018 downregulated, 2,802 upregulated.
specification.specification_gaps: The paper does not specify: (1) the exact version of the safflower reference transcriptome used for read mapping; (2) whether the counts are based on genes or transcripts; (3) the exact parameters for RSEM and DESeq2 beyond the thresholds; (4) how multiple testing correction was applied across all genes; (5) the handling of multi-mapping reads; (6) the exact definition of 'differentially expressed' in terms of FDR and log2FC cutoffs (stated as |log2FC| ≥ 1 and FDR < 0.05, but not whether these were applied simultaneously).
